resources.string: OEA Assistant lets OEA Launcher perform actions you ask for: double-tap to lock the screen, swipe down for notifications, open the real Recents screen, create split-screen pairs on older Android versions, and run the OEA App Freezer. When you freeze apps without root, OEA opens each app\'s Android App info page and presses Force stop for you. OEA Assistant only acts when you trigger one of these OEA actions. It does not read, store or send your screen content or typed text.
Lock, notifications, Recents, split screen and App Freezer for OEA Launcher
